title: 第一卷 第11章 山贼猎熊第一卷 第12章 螳螂捕蝉黄雀在后
slug: 武道长生从猎户开始刷熟练度修行
lines: 前方林间空地一片狼藉。
十余名剽悍武者正围杀一头狰狞怪熊。
这畜生肩背高高隆起，肌肉贲张如花岗岩石块，黑毛油亮如钢针，浑身散发浓烈的凶煞之气。
最惊人的是它宽阔的脊背：从后颈到尾椎，生着一层青黑色的、甲壳般的厚重角质层，泛着金属光泽。
刀剑砍上去，只能留下淡淡白痕。
黑熊人立而起，右掌横扫。
碗口粗的松树被掌缘擦中，树皮瞬间炸裂，木屑纷飞，主干竟被拍得歪斜欲倒。
掌风呼啸，三丈内落叶被卷上半空。
那群汉子亦非庸手，人人身材魁梧，气血澎湃，皆是武者，随便拉一个出来，都不比宋忠弱。
他们目光凶狠，言行举止间更有一股剽悍匪气。
有人一边猛攻一边大笑：“头儿，拿下这头妖熊献给大当家，您这大头目的位置可就稳了！”
“哈哈哈！
等大当家修为突破，咱们还用窝在深山里？早晚带兄弟们去周边村堡，吃香喝辣！”
“兄弟们加把劲，宰了这畜生，回去咱们好好庆祝！”
疤脸汉子也是狂笑数声，手中攻势更猛。
他名叫赵天虎，是大王山黑风寨一个头目，此次带领喽啰进山狩猎，意外发现了这头妖熊。
一路追猎，在此地将之围困。
妖兽本就难猎杀，何况是以防御著称的铁背黑熊？它不管不顾，横冲直撞，眼看又要逃窜。
“缠住它！”
疤脸汉子赵天虎厉声大喝。
他**的上身筋肉虬结，此刻皮肤赤红，血管在皮下如蚯蚓般蠕动。
——这是将气血催动到极致的表现。
他手中那柄九环大刀，刀刃处隐约有一层血芒在流转。
六名山贼分成三组，手握浸过桐油、掺了牛筋的绞索。
他们配合默契，两人甩索缠住熊腿，另外四人立即拽紧，脚蹬地面，浑身肌肉鼓胀发力。
黑熊被绊得一个踉跄，暴怒转身。
但它转身的瞬间，另外两组绳索又缠了上来。
六名汉子齐声暴喝，气血灌注双臂，青筋暴起，竟将这千斤巨兽生生拖拽得动作迟滞。
赵天虎抓住机会，脚下一蹬，地面泥土炸开浅坑。
他身形如离弦之箭窜出，双手握刀，刀身上的气血红芒骤然浓烈三分，刀刃破空时竟发出低沉嗡鸣。
“噗嗤！”
这一刀狠狠斩在黑熊肩胛处的旧伤上——那里之前已被劈开一道口子，黑毛焦糊，皮肉翻卷。
刀锋入肉近尺，却被那层铁背角质死死卡住。
黑熊痛极狂吼，左掌带着恶风拍向赵天虎头颅！
赵天虎竟不松刀，左手成拳，拳面上同样裹着一层薄薄气血，悍然迎上！
拳掌交击，气浪四散。
赵天虎脚下地面寸寸皲裂，双腿陷入泥土半尺，口鼻溢出一缕鲜血，却死死顶住了这恐怖一掌。
content_en:
The clearing ahead was a mess.
More than ten fierce warriors were surrounding and killing a ferocious monster bear.
The beast's shoulders and back were bulging high, its muscles were as taut as granite stones, its black hair was as shiny as steel needles, and it exuded a strong and evil aura.
The most astonishing thing is its broad back: from the back of the neck to the tail vertebra, there is a thick layer of blue-black, carapace-like cuticle, glowing with metallic luster.
The sword slashed forward, leaving only a faint white mark.
"Ho--!"
The black bear man stood up and swept his right palm across.
The pine tree as thick as a bowl was hit by the edge of the palm, and the bark burst instantly, sawdust flew, and the main trunk was tilted to the point of falling.
The wind roared in the palm, and the fallen leaves within three feet were swept into the air.
Those men are not mediocre. They are all tall and strong, with surging energy and blood. They are all warriors. If you pull any one of them out, they will not be weaker than Song Zhong.
Their eyes were fierce, and their words and deeds had a fierce and gangster air.
Someone laughed while attacking fiercely: "Boss, take this demon bear and offer it to the boss. Your position as the boss will be secure!"
"Hahaha!
When the master's cultivation reaches a breakthrough, why should we still stay in the mountains? Take the brothers to the surrounding villages and forts in the morning and evening to enjoy delicious food and drink! "
"Brothers, work harder and kill this beast. Let's celebrate when we go back!"
The scar-faced man also laughed wildly, and his attacks became even fiercer.
His name is Zhao Tianhu, and he is a leader of the Black Wind Village in Dawang Mountain. This time he led his men into the mountain for hunting and accidentally discovered this demonic bear.
He hunted all the way and surrounded him here.
Monsters are difficult to hunt, let alone the iron-backed black bear known for its defense? It didn't care, ran rampant, and was about to escape again.
"Hold it!"
The scar-faced man Zhao Tianhu shouted loudly.
The muscles of his naked upper body were knotted, the skin was red at the moment, and the blood vessels were crawling under the skin like earthworms.
——This is a manifestation of stimulating Qi and blood to the extreme.
The nine-ringed sword in his hand had a faint layer of blood flowing around the blade.
The six bandits were divided into three groups, holding nooses soaked in tung oil and mixed with beef tendon.
They cooperated tacitly, and the two of them swung the ropes around the bear's legs, and the other four immediately tightened them, pushing their feet on the ground, and their muscles bulged and exerted force.
The black bear stumbled and turned around angrily.
But the moment it turned around, another two sets of ropes were wrapped around it.
The six men shouted loudly in unison, blood poured into their arms, veins popped out, and they actually dragged the giant beast that weighed 1,000 kilograms until its movements were sluggish.
"Up!"
Zhao Tianhu seized the opportunity and kicked off his feet, causing a shallow pit to explode in the ground.
He shot out like an arrow from a string, holding a knife in both hands. The red glow of Qi and blood on the knife suddenly became three-points stronger, and the blade actually made a low buzzing sound when it broke through the air.
"Pfft!"
This knife struck hard on the old wound on the black bear's shoulder blade - there had been a cut there before, the black hair was scorched, and the skin and flesh were rolled.
The blade of the knife penetrated the flesh nearly a foot, but was stuck tightly by the layer of iron-backed horniness.
The black bear roared in agony, and slapped Zhao Tianhu's head with his left palm with evil wind!
Zhao Tianhu didn't let go of the sword, and formed a fist with his left hand. The surface of the fist was also covered with a thin layer of Qi and blood, and he faced it bravely!
"Bang!"
The fists and palms clashed, and the air waves scattered.
The ground under Zhao Tianhu's feet was cracked, his legs sunk half a foot into the soil, and a stream of blood spilled from his mouth and nose, but he firmly withstood the terrifying palm.
